_doc: Ashfall survivors buildings atlas v1. See buildings/HANDOFF-buildings.md. rect = [x,y,w,h] in the atlas. Base frames: anchor = bottom-centre of the footprint inside the rect; footprint_origin = top-left corner of the footprint inside the rect, so draw at (tx*32 - footprint_origin[0], ty*32 - footprint_origin[1]). Sprites may rise above the footprint. Top frames (turret/bone spire heads): anchor = rotation pivot; draw the pivot at base rect + turret_mount. Pad frames: 32x32 ground decal for the dock pad tile. shadow: drawn by the engine first, 30% black, offset (+3,+3) from the footprint. No baked shadow. LOOP 5 new content (walls, gates, towers). Walls: 16 autotiles {id}-mNN-{team} by 4-neighbour mask + construct; crack1/2 (damaged <50%) and tear1/2 (critical <25%) are overlays; rubble1/2 are team-less ground decals. Gates: {id}-{h|v}-f0..f3 open anim, construct, damaged/critical overlays, destroyed. Locked = f0 + ui lock icon. See loop5/HANDOFF-loop5.md.
